prompt.project_info: Create a bright photorealistic Mediterranean poolside portrait with natural warm tones and realistic skin texture.
prompt.main_subject: An adult blonde woman with light sun-kissed skin, messy high bun, loose strands, small rectangular sunglasses, minimal summer makeup, and a neutral calm confident expression. She wears a black one-piece swimsuit with cream detail and an oversized white shirt draped open.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing upright at the pool ladder with one leg slightly forward, arms relaxed near the shirt, medium-full-body vertical frame from head to upper thighs, subject centered. Show clear turquoise water, stone pool deck, white umbrellas, loungers, pine trees, terrace railing, and bright resort context.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High midday natural daylight, soft shadows, bright warm summer atmosphere, realistic matte fabric and natural skin detail.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm slightly low angle with eye-level torso focus, sharp subject and slightly soft background, vertical portrait, clean high-resolution photorealism.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic bright Mediterranean poolside portrait of an adult blonde woman with light sun-kissed skin, messy high bun, loose strands around her face, small rectangular dark sunglasses, minimal summer makeup, and a neutral calm confident expression. She wears a black one-piece swimsuit with cream/ivory detail and an oversized white shirt worn open. She stands upright at a pool ladder with one leg slightly forward and relaxed arms near the shirt. Centered medium-full-body vertical frame from head to upper thighs, clear turquoise water, stone deck, white umbrellas, loungers, large green pine trees, and terrace railing. High midday natural daylight, soft shadows, warm summer atmosphere, 35mm slightly low angle, sharp subject, slightly softened background, realistic skin and fabric texture.
